mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) and dehydration may potentiate carisoprodol's CNS depression and increase risk of syncope, while carisoprodol may impair fluid/electrolyte management awareness.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes, renal function, and blood pressure regularly; educate patient on orthostatic precautions and fluid intake; consider alternative muscle relaxant if possible.
